MAHANADI STEEL CORPORATION 
 
 PSU CLIENT · Madhya Pradesh · IN 
 
 REFERENCE LETTER 
 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern 
 
 Ref: REF/27/42 Date: 31/03/2026 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern, 
 
 This letter is issued at the request of National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. to
 confirm that the said agency has executed work for this organisation as detailed
 below and that their performance has been found satisfactory. 
 
 1. PROJECT DETAILS 
 
 Project Name Rigid Pavement - Madhya Pradesh Pkg-49 
 
 Scope of Work Roads Highways works for Mahanadi Steel 
 Corporation completed 2025. 
 Nature of Work Roads Highways 
 
 Contract Value Rs. 29.87 Crore 
 Date of Completion 2025-02-26 
 
 Contractor's Role JV Partner 
 
 2. PERFORMANCE ASSESSMENT 
 
 Throughout the engagement the agency's conduct was responsive throughout the
 defect liability period, and . On that basis the agency may be invited for
 future tenders in this category. 
 
 CRITERION RATING OBSERVATION 
 
 Adherence to Schedule Excellent Project delivered within contractual timeline
 Quality of Work Excellent Workmanship meets or exceeds specifications 
 
 Safety Record Good BOCW Act compliance maintained throughout 
 Responsiveness Excellent Prompt resolution of site issues and RFIs 
 
 Financial Integrity Good Billing was accurate and supported by records
 
 3. RECOMMENDATION 
 
 The contractor's planning, quality control and coordination with this office
 were of a good standard, and the work was commissioned without outstanding
 defects. 
 We have no hesitation in recommending National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for
 similar assignments in the future. This reference is valid for a period of High
 
 from the date of this letter.
